claims.citation: New York Herald, 20 July 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Bark Sounding[?] Billow, Vidulich, Menton May 30, with
lemons, to Lawrence, Giles & Co. June 18, lat 36 30, lon 17 30,
spoke ship E Sherman, from Gottenburg for Port Adelaide;
July 4, lat 40, lon 49, brig Maria Rito[?] (Sp), from Havana for
Sunderland, 25 days out.
